Training data attribution: Banking77 (Casanueva et al., 2020, PolyAI), MASSIVE (FitzGerald et al., 2022, Amazon), and the CC-BY sources in DATA_LICENSES.md. sources.title: GitHub - BEKO2210/statim: Native C++20 engine for System-1 decision ...
sources.snippet: A native C++20 engine for System-1 decision models. Typed decisions — choice, score, noul — over any text or JSON in a single forward pass, served from one static binary.
